description: ANHRI search previews give 15 social/labor entries for 1–15 February and 14 for 15–28 February (29 total), but no complete February roster was transcribed into this unit. The January-unit body read for EG202101-S005 identifies a continuing Helwan sit-in; the remaining entries and eligibility filters are unresolved.
required_followup: Read the exact first- and second-half report bodies, map each roster item to a contemporary source, and assess public gathering, onset, >=50 turnout, domestic state target and event-level response separately.

description: Tanta candidate S016 and similar S017 remain search-only. One exact Cairo24 and one exact ElNabaa web.open each returned Cache miss without an HTTP status or article text. description: The Tanta search previews say “hundreds” and connect a closure to COVID enforcement, but turnout basis, executed gathering, precise demand, state-policy target, duration and response are not verified; Cairo24 and ElNabaa may be reporting one story.

description: The second-half monitor preview mentions a Beila lawyers’ sit-in and “dozens” after a reported police-guard assault. “Dozens” does not establish >=50, and the exact date, public action, demand and state target are unknown.
required_followup: Read the report and underlying contemporary story; verify event date, crowd count, demand, state target and response.

description: The Cairo24 preview says 36 Saris El-Layan–Menouf route drivers considered a work stoppage over fines and that 15 threatened, but did not begin, a hunger strike. If 36 is the full group, it falls below the threshold; the preview does not establish a public gathering or actual protest event.
required_followup: Read the report body and determine whether a distinct public gathering occurred, whether the reported group count covers the action, and whether there is any separate >=50 state-targeted episode.

description: The prior-month owner has a Helwan sit-in beginning 17 January; a prior-unit body-read ANHRI roster identifies it as continuing in the first half of February. No February-specific end date, crowd size, state response or change in demands is established here.
required_followup: Keep Egypt January as owner; find contemporaneous February and post-February records to establish physical continuation, any changed episode scope and end.
